title: Near-linear equivalence testing for propositional Horn theories
formal: Can equivalence of two propositional Horn CNF formulas be decided in \(O(N\log N)\) time, where \(N\) is their combined number of literal occurrences?

import_provenance.original_title: Near-linear equivalence testing for propositional Horn theories
import_provenance.original_statement: Can equivalence of two propositional Horn CNF formulas be decided in O(N log N), or even O(N), time, where N is their combined number of literal occurrences? This would improve the quadratic general algorithm while preserving the ability to compare complete sets of logical consequences.
